The theorem in `/work/cam_0697.lean` is now proved, and the file compiles with `lean /work/cam_0697.lean` producing no errors and no `sorry` warning.

The proof checks convexity directly from the definition, since Mathlib has no ready-made lemma for convexity of this infimum. For points `x`, `y` and weights `a`, `b`, it takes near-optimal pairs `(c1, d1)` and `(c2, d2)` for each point, and combines them as `a•c1 + b•c2` and `a•d1 + b•d2`. By the triangle inequality, the distance at the mixed point is at most `a` times the first distance plus `b` times the second. Since `sInf` is at most any member of the set, the bound follows up to an arbitrary `ε`.

Only the proof body was replaced; the imports, the statement and the namespace are unchanged. I left a backup at `/work/cam_0697.bak` and a scratch snippet at `/work/body.txt`, which you may want to delete.
